race.comment: HEY JUDE (1) is the horse to beat after a BM66 third at Nowra where she was a well-supported favourite, began awkwardly and still worked into the race well enough to be beaten just under three lengths. Her start prior in BM68 company was plain, but the return to a BM58 and a proven 1400m profile give her a strong platform. COLORADO SUN (6) has been safely held in two Canberra runs, yet both were in CL2 and CL1 company. Winkers replace the blinkers now and this looks a golden opportunity for him to get back to winning form. PETOMAI (7) brings upside after charging home to win a Mdn at Canberra first-up, and did so with good splits. 1400m doesn't look an issue and he can show it wasn't a fluke. SURE INTENTIONS (8) was beaten a nose at Nowra when resuming and has enough 1400m evidence to press for another placing if he repeats that effort. ADAPTATION (2) can keep the ball rolling after a last start win at Nowra.
